status: PROPOSAL ONLY, not a registration. Registration waits until the roadmap and the user fix the first mitochondrion milestone's scope (D193 (C), D138), and is made before any engine output exists.
subject: One lumped isolated cardiac mitochondrion in a held buffer (host P: matrix, intermembrane-space node, buffer), Beard 2005 as corrected in 2006

judging.R1_published_vs_published_figures: reported, not judged (digitised curves carry +-1 px and unreported inputs; README 'Reproduction')
judging.R1_published_vs_R2: judged as the references' own check once R2 (the CellML file in libOpenCOR, D193 (B)) exists; R1 never reads it

R1_published.note: Eq. 24 carries Eq. 7's proton term because the published curves were computed with it (Q02); Eqs. 11 and 16 as printed because the published curves support them (Q03, Q11).

R1_declared.why: The engine admits only cycle laws whose zero is their reaction's equilibrium and which dissipate at every state (design note Sec. 1.4). Eqs. 11 and 16, as printed and as run, fail both (audit: zero offsets and negative-dissipation states), so the engine cannot run them. Each switch is one declared departure, sized against R1_published in the reproduction record. Cytochrome c sits in the intermembrane space (Q05); this moves transients only. The rapid Mg2+-binding limit (X_MgA large, D1) is needed for any transient protocol: as printed, an ADP step drives IMS free ADP negative (Q15).
engine_departures_still_to_declare: D1 Mg2+ binding as a rapid closure: no effect on any steady state (binding is at equilibrium there for any X_MgA); transients only
D2 matrix H+ buffering by a declared buffer species instead of rbuff^-1 = (100 M^-1)[H+]x: changes the charge invariant's form, so the inventory anchor is re-solved; size to be measured
D5 outer membrane as a face: Eq. 13 is linear permeation of totals with no outer-membrane potential; the face law's form at zero outer potential decides whether this is a departure
not_departures: D3: X_F1 = 150.93 is finite in Table 1
D4: R1 already uses the SI 2019 constants; B05 states none

departure_sizes_vs_R1_published.all_switches (thermo_consistent): dPsi 1.35 mV, pH_x 0.0079, NADH 0.023, cytochrome c 0.0055, O2 flux 2.8% (27, 16, 46, 11, 28 bands)

inputs_to_fix_at_registration: T: 298.15 K (B05 states none; 298.15 K reproduces the published P50 and cytochrome c curves at rms z 1.98; 310.15 K misses cytochrome c by a factor 1.33 and P50 by 2, rms z 25.9)

matrix Mg2+ total, an initial inventory B05 never reports (Eq. 22 conserves it): R1 declares 1 mM; the published curves fit best near 5 mM, the buffer's total and B05's only Mg2+ number (rms z 1.40), so 5 mM is the recommended registered value

matrix charge inventory as an explicit number, not only a pH anchor: Eq. 22 conserves V_x (ln[H+]x/(100 M^-1) + [K+]x - [NADH]x - [ATP]x - 2[Pi]x) + C_IM dPsi; the Fig. 4D anchor gives -0.018154 mol per l mito (298.15 K, 1 mM Mg2+). The engine's buffer model (D2) changes this function, so the engine registers its own value from the same anchor
IMS free Mg2+ rule (not a state in B05): R1 uses the buffer's free Mg2+ from its 5.0 mM total; using 5.0 mM as free moves the states by up to 13 bands
[Pi]e for the low-oxygen rows (B05 states none): 10 mM reproduces the published P50 (0.3751 against 0.373 uM); the text's 14% cytochrome c fits about 4 mM (13.2% at 3 mM, 15.3% at 10 mM)

rows.conditions: pH_e 7.1, K_e 150 mM, buffer Mg2+ total 5.0 mM, ATP_e = AMP_e = 0, O2 26 uM (B05)
rows.band_basis: a stated physical scale: about a third of the published figures' 1-px resolution (0.13 mV, 0.0033 pH, 0.001 fraction), far above R1's convergence floor (integration vs exact Newton below 2e-13 relative; Newton residual below 1e-40)

rows.what: Eq. 22's two invariants over every run: matrix Mg2+ total and matrix charge
rows.band: relative drift 1e-9 of the run's initial value
rows.band_basis: exact conservation; 1e-9 is a ledger-scale tolerance

rows.what: every process's dissipation -J dG >= 0 at every SS state, and each cycle law's zero at its reaction's equilibrium (zero offset, kJ/mol)
rows.band_basis: sign is exact; the offset tolerance is a numerical scale

rows.what: low oxygen: P50 of state-3 O2 flux ([ADP]e 1.0 mM, [ATP]e 0, [Pi]e 10 mM) and the cytochrome c reduced fraction at 50 uM O2 ([ADP]e 0.5, [ATP]e 0.87, [Pi]e 10 mM)
the dehydrogenase's implied affinity RT ln(r[NAD]/[NADH]) and its flux at every SS state
rows.why: Eq. 1 has no reductant, so its free energy is booked as declared work (design note Sec. 1.4 item 4); R1 reports the number the booking must reproduce

rows.what: time course of the [ADP]e step 0 -> 1.3 mM -> 0 at [Pi]e 10 mM (reproduce.adp_step_time_course), run in the rapid Mg2+-binding limit: X_MgA overridden to 1e9 or more (departure D1). As printed (X_MgA = 1e6) the step drives IMS free ADP negative within microseconds and Eq. 14 diverges (Q15)
rows.band_basis: R1's own spread: rtol 1e-8 vs 1e-10 differ by 4.4e-8 mV, and X_MgA 1e9 vs 1e10 by 4.5e-5 mV and 4.5e-7 in NADH; the band is a physical scale far above both. The trajectory depends on Q05, C_IM, X_MgA and X_AK
